title: Acyclicity after appending gates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $gs$ be an acyclic finite list of gates starting from index bound $n$. If every input index read by every gate in a finite extension $ext$ is less than $n+|gs|$, then the concatenation $gs$ followed by $ext$ is acyclic starting from $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $ext$ is a finite list of gates
every input index of every gate in $ext$ is less than $n+|gs|$
